svg.title: D67: The path a board takes
svg.desc: D67 is a flow diagram, not to scale. Six steps run left to right, each with the Part of the book that covers it: the design package (Part 1), the panel (Part 2), bare-board fabrication (Part 3), assembly (Part 5), test and programming (Part 6), and packing and shipping (Part 7). Components and materials (Part 4) feed into assembly from above, alongside the bare boards. A bar under every step shows working with a manufacturer (Part 8), which runs through the whole path.

g.text: Working with a manufacturer, at every step
Cost, lead time, prototype to production, and design reviews
